summary.headline: Q2 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin fell to 7% (INR177m) as grain, glass and PET costs squeezed IMFL Proprietary margins to about 10%.
summary.overview: Consolidated net revenue rose 7% YoY to INR2,716 million in Q2 FY27, with EBITDA of INR177 million (7% margin) and PAT of INR80 million. Alcobev revenue grew 14% YoY to INR1,953 million, led by IMFL Proprietary, which grew 39% to INR577 million but at a 10% EBITDA margin versus a historical 13-14%. Ethanol revenue was INR763 million at a 1% EBITDA margin amid oversupply and elevated maize and grain prices. Management launched Arcana tequila (INR7,500 per bottle, Madhya Pradesh only) and Kultur hard seltzer, and reported the malt plant maturing ahead of utilisation from Q3 FY28.

financial_highlights.change: hit by inbrew move from licensing to contract manufacturing

segments.name: Alcobev (IMFL Proprietary, IMIL, IMFL Licensing, ENA)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR1,953 million (+14% YoY), EBITDA INR168 million (9% margin). IMFL Proprietary volumes grew 28% in Q2 and 34% in H1; Central Province series volumes up 56% in Q2.

segments.name: IMFL Proprietary
segments.commentary: Revenue INR577 million (+39% YoY), EBITDA margin about 10%. Long-term margin target 15-17%; management expects a return to 13-14% over time. Prestige & Above is only about 4-5% of current portfolio.

segments.name: Ethanol
segments.commentary: Revenue INR763 million with 1% EBITDA margin. H1 volumes up 10% YoY, plant at about 95% utilisation in H1. Q2 ENA volume rose 36% to 7.4 million litres (captive plus third-party sales).

guidance_outlook: IMFL Proprietary volume growth guided at 30-35%; management says it is on track.
Margins expected to improve from April 2027 via price hikes in certain states, with mix shift to premium brands and malt plant benefits.
Management sees IMFL Proprietary EBITDA margin recovering to about 13-14% through a combination of levers, not in the near term.
Near-term gross margin of 45% not achievable at current raw material prices per CFO; 45% possible only if input costs revert to Q1/Q2 levels.
Kultur and tequila expected to add about INR10 crore to top line next year, with upside if demand is strong.
Around 5% of top line expected to go to brand building for premium brands.
Malt utilisation to begin from Q3 FY28; Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh entry targeted by end FY27.
capex_capacity: Malt plant of 6,000 litres per day commissioned in September 2025; maturation started November 2025 with French and American casks being procured.
Malt maturation adds around INR3 crore per month to inventory; utilisation expected from Q3 FY28.
Ethanol plant operated at around 95% capacity utilisation in H1 FY27.
IMIL brand volumes of 0.90 million cases in Q2, broadly flat YoY in Madhya Pradesh.
Brandy launch pending due to import issues.
demand_pricing: Ethanol: market supply exceeds demand, pressuring realisations; maize price around INR30,000 per tonne, substantially higher YoY.
OMC tender for maize-based ethanol cut to INR68 from INR71.8 per litre; 36-40% of allocation is FCI rice.
Raw material cost rise of about INR2,000-2,500 per tonne QoQ; PET bottle price up from INR101 to INR145 per kg; glass bottle prices up about 30%.

Tequila: niche category under 1% of Indian IMFL, about 25,000-30,000 cases per year, growing 35-40% annually. Arcana sells at INR32,000-35,000 per case vs company average IMFL realisation of about INR800 per case.
Sold about 40 cases of tequila in the first month in Madhya Pradesh; registrations in other states expected before New Year.
Marketing spend rose to about INR2-2.5 crore in Q2 from about INR50-60 lakh a year earlier, plus about INR2-2.5 crore margin hit from raw material inflation.

qa_highlights.question: Why did IMFL Proprietary margins fall despite volume growth, and what is the recovery path?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed it to grain, glass and PET cost inflation plus brand-building spend. Proprietary EBITDA margin is about 10-11% versus 13-14% earlier. Recovery depends on premium mix, lower input costs, April price hikes and malt plant benefits.

qa_highlights.question: What is the outlook for raw material, power and other expense headers for Q3 and Q4?
qa_highlights.answer: Maize is stable at about INR30,000 per tonne. Management expects easing within about a month as FCI rice allocation and the January new crop arrive. Other expenses rose on contract manufacturing (about 50-60% higher, INR2.5 crore) and selling costs (INR3 crore), with about INR13 crore higher in H1 YoY.

qa_highlights.question: Why is gross margin falling versus peers such as Allied Blenders?
qa_highlights.answer: The CFO said the company is concentrated in popular-category brands, which are linked to commodity prices, while peers are in prestige and premium segments. Gross margin is expected to improve as premium mix grows.

qa_highlights.question: What is the breakdown of the INR3 crore excess cost versus normal IMFL margin?
qa_highlights.answer: Branding and advertising spend of about INR2-2.5 crore against INR50-60 lakh a year earlier, plus about INR2-2.5 crore impact from raw material inflation. Marketing goes to digital, schemes, HoReCa and Maharashtra market entry.

qa_highlights.question: What is the status of the CCI case, FSSAI stay and ethanol supply outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: CCI matter: High Court ruling went against the company; it has appealed to the Supreme Court and the state government is also defending. FSSAI: company holds a Madhya Pradesh High Court stay and says there has been no monetary loss. Ethanol: a mix of maize and FCI rice is planned to secure supply.

qa_highlights.question: What tequila and Kultur revenue contribution and success metrics are expected?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects about INR10 crore of top-line contribution next year from Kultur and tequila. Success would be shown by reaching 4-5% of the national premium tequila market share in the first year, then 10%.

risks_watch: Raw material inflation (grain, glass, PET) keeping IMFL Proprietary EBITDA margin near 10% and consolidated margin low.
Ethanol losses from oversupply and high grain prices; ethanol EBITDA margin at 1%.
Brand-building spend of about 5% of top line may keep Alcobev margins under pressure.
Pending legal matters: Supreme Court CCI case (adverse High Court outcome) and FSSAI stay in Madhya Pradesh.
Brandy launch delayed by import issues; tequila registrations outside Madhya Pradesh still pending.
Working capital tied up in malt inventory (about INR3 crore per month).
summary.management_tone: Confident on volume growth and the premium portfolio plan, but cautious and at times evasive on margin recovery and timing. Management repeatedly attributed margin pressure to unprecedented input cost inflation and stated that near-term 45% gross margin is not achievable.
key_quotes: So we expect the margins to increase, say, from April onwards, because as the raw material prices will increase, we will also definitely take a price hike in across the states.
So right now it's stabilized at INR30,000 per ton, which is substantially high as compared to last year and last month as well.
Our long-term aim for IMFL margin remains in the range of 15% to 17%.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Management guides IMFL Proprietary EBITDA margin back to 13-14% from April 2027 via price hikes in some states, premium mix and malt benefits, from about 10% in Q2 FY27; consolidated margin was 7% and ethanol was 1%.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Malt plant of 6,000 litres per day was commissioned Sept 2025 and utilisation starts Q3 FY28, outside most of the window; ethanol plant ran at about 95% utilisation in H1 FY27 with no new ethanol capacity discussed.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: IMFL Proprietary volume growth guided at 30-35% for FY27, with H1 at +34% and Q2 at +28%, and management says it is on track.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Ethanol plant is at about 95% utilisation in H1 FY27, but no new capex was discussed; the only capacity addition is the malt plant already commissioned.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management says near-term 45% gross margin is not achievable at current raw material prices, and consolidated EBITDA margin is only 7%, so a guidance raise looks unlikely.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Grain, glass and PET inflation (PET up from INR101 to INR145 per kg, glass up about 30%) is keeping IMFL Proprietary margin near 10%, and the CFO says input costs may ease only within about a month.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Arcana tequila and Kultur hard seltzer launched, with about 40 cases sold in the first month in Madhya Pradesh and other state registrations expected before New Year; brandy launch pending import issues.

rows.label: Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh entry by end FY27
rows.why: Management targets Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh entry by end FY27, and tequila registrations in other states are expected before New Year.

rows.label: Price hikes in certain states from April 2027
rows.why: Management expects margin improvement from April 2027 through price hikes in certain states, which is the main lever for the 13-14% margin return.

rows.label: Kultur and tequila add about INR10 crore revenue next year
rows.why: Management expects Kultur and tequila to contribute about INR10 crore to the top line next year, with upside if demand is strong, though tequila is only about 40 cases a month so far in Madhya Pradesh.
